reason: Make invalid provider/factor/HTTP contract distinct from a finite parser observation before public registration
rule: Invalid/no fallback refers to missing, malformed, invalid-factor or HTTP/contract evidence. literalInventory observation.valid:false alone is not a provider/factor error and is not a new eligibility veto.
